2608.03803.title: M-GATE: Multilingual Grammar, Accuracy in Translation, and Efficiency Benchmark for Large Language Models
2608.03803.paper_summary: Multilingual language models are deployed across a hundred or more languages, yet most benchmarks test whether a model can perform a task _in_ a language rather than whether it commands the language itself, conflating fluency with proficiency. We introduce M-GATE (Multilingual Grammar, Accuracy in Translation, and Efficiency), a benchmark of linguistic proficiency spanning 30 typologically diverse languages from high- to low-resource. M-GATE comprises three tasks: grammatical error detection on linguist-crafted, adversarially selected sentences that turn on hard, language-specific phenomena; round-trip translation of shared English sources across 29 target languages, scored by a three-provider LLM judge panel validated against professional annotators; and a supplementary tokenizer-efficiency measure. We evaluate over 50 models in more than 80 configurations. Fluency and proficiency come apart sharply: models that translate competently sit near chance on the adversarial grammar items, the best reaching a Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) of only 0.36, and their errors lean systematically toward under-flagging, accepting ungrammatical text rather than raising false alarms. Translation quality closely tracks a language's share of pretraining data (r = 0.86 against log Common Crawl share), producing a steep low-resource penalty that is nonetheless narrowing with successive model releases. Enabling reasoning reliably improves translation, while its effect on error detection is smaller and for some models negative, so the best configuration is task-dependent. To resist contamination, test items are kept private behind a continuously updated public leaderboard, with illustrative examples released (https://m-gate.ai).
2608.03803.paper_summary_zh: 多語言模型已在一百種或更多語言中部署，但大多數基準測試的是模型是否能在某種語言中執行任務，而不是它是否掌握該語言本身，將流利度與熟練度混為一談。我們介紹了 M-GATE（多語言語法、翻譯準確性與效率），這是一個涵蓋30種類型學上多樣語言的語言熟練度基準，從高資源到低資源。M-GATE 包含三個任務：在語言學家創作的、經過對抗性選擇的句子上進行語法錯誤檢測，這些句子涉及困難的語言特定現象；對29種目標語言的共享英語來源進行往返翻譯，由三個提供者的 LLM 評審小組評分，並與專業標註者進行驗證；以及一個補充的分詞器效率測量。我們在超過80個配置中評估了50多個模型。流利度和熟練度之間的區別非常明顯：能夠勝任翻譯的模型在對抗性語法項目上接近隨機，最佳模型的馬修斯相關係數（MCC）僅為0.36，且它們的錯誤系統性地傾向於低標記，接受不合語法的文本而不是引發虛假警報。翻譯質量與語言的預訓練數據佔比密切相關（r = 0.86 對數的 Common Crawl 佔比），產生了陡峭的低資源懲罰，但隨著後續模型的發布而逐漸縮小。可靠的推理能力能改善翻譯，而對錯誤檢測的影響較小，對某些模型甚至是負面的，因此最佳配置取決於任務。為了抵抗污染，測試項目保持私密，並隱藏在持續更新的公共排行榜後面，並釋放了說明性示例（https://m-gate.ai）。
